title: Development of a Novel Prognostic Model for Predicting Lymph Node Metastasis in Early Colorectal Cancer: Analysis Based on the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Database.
summary: Among 26,733 early CRC cases, the top model reported accuracy 96.0%, sensitivity 99.7%, specificity 92.9% and AUC 0.991.
ai_technology: Logistic regression, XGBoost, KNN, trees, SVM, neural network and random forest estimated lymph-node metastasis from SEER variables.
